title: Preymaker
versionviewed: Live homepage partially rendered; Awwwards 2026-09/Oct 6 2026 gallery stills and sampled recordings. No full playback claim.
palette: Black/white UI; silver-gray device/studio presentation in gallery; film imagery supplies blue-gray, green, and natural color. Proposed hex tokens are design choices, not sampled source values.
type: Oversized uppercase sans wordmark and headings; very small sans navigation/service labels; dense white sans case-study paragraphs over full-bleed film stills; huge black office names on sparse white contact rows. Exact font not verified.
material: Cinematic photographic/VFX image planes, tactile reflective silver device framing, almost unstyled information chrome. Craft comes from image resolution, crop, tonal depth, and type scale, not decorative cards.
firstviewtopology: Live homepage: giant PREYMAKER wordmark spans upper width; tiny MENU centrally and SEARCH right; short two-line positioning sits near bottom center; Scroll Down opposite bottom edge. Media behind this frame failed to render here, so black is NOT accepted as the intended hero. Gallery case-study samples show edge-to-edge imagery, central title, then left-lower prose with persistent top navigation.
navigationreadinggrammar: Live scroll changed document content/position but film planes stayed black. MENU click attempted; screenshot timed out. Retrieved actual site anchors for Work, Case Studies, Showreels, Capabilities, Technology, Contact, News. Sampled gallery recording 0 at 1/3s shows mountain image then small lower-right technology prose; recording 1 at 1/3s shows film title then substantial bottom-left prose. Contact archive is a white ruled table with large location names rather than cards. These are archived frames, not personally tested transitions.
mobileobservable: Awwwards mobile still is a device-in-studio mockup showing a narrow black scrolling text/partner list; not actual live mobile interaction evidence. Keep one-column reading and large image crop, but do not infer tap/scroll performance from this mockup.
issues: Homepage image planes black after initial wait plus bounded wait; menu capture timed out. Invalid live media captures excluded.

prototypeprinciples.name: Wideframe / personal moving-image essay
prototypeprinciples.visitor_action: Read a visually authored sequence about Victor, then choose a chapter or contact without operating a game.
prototypeprinciples.environment_camera: Full-width cinematic crops of original small personal technology still-life scenes; chapter changes use deliberate image masking, not a 3D room to walk through.
prototypeprinciples.palette_system: Silver/white essay and contact pages alternate with near-black image chapters; cool blue-gray photographic light plus restrained natural image color. No obligatory amber/copper.
prototypeprinciples.type_system: Large condensed or grotesk sans chapter headings, precise tiny labels, 16–18px readable prose. Original name typography instead of copied corporate wordmark.
prototypeprinciples.first_view: Victor name or an original short line at architectural scale over one authored image; tiny chapter navigation; short factual descriptor; visible scroll cue.
prototypeprinciples.reading_system: Approach becomes a filmstrip essay: large still, caption, short paragraph, next still. About uses a white editorial spread. Contact is a sparse ruled information sheet with real LinkedIn, contained freelance scope and full-time status—not office addresses, clients, reels or testimonials.
prototypeprinciples.signature_interaction: One film-frame crop expands into chapter imagery on selection; scroll reveals caption/prose without losing navigation. Provide instant no-motion change and image fallback.
prototypeprinciples.mobile_plan: Static authored poster replaces heavy motion; portrait-safe crops; stacked 16px essay paragraphs in document scroll; Menu exposes ordinary chapter links; never overlay long text on busy footage.
prototypeprinciples.feasible_original_assets: Author original lit SVG/canvas or detailed WebGL still-life of cables, a self-hosted server front, PCB-like personal curiosity objects, and paper notes. Capture rendered stills locally, optional self-generated short camera motion using available tools. Reference films/screenshots stay private research only. Do not pretend synthetic scenes are real project photographs.
prototypeprinciples.provenance: Borrow editorial image scale, chapter mask and white ruled contact grammar; no Preymaker film, logo, client names, offices, awards, source code or VFX claims.
prototypeprinciples.avoid_siblings: Not a futuristic sculpture archive, scenic terrain journey, desktop OS, lantern room, or gallery of collectible dioramas.

research_scope: Research only; pinned reference; no UI build; no accepted ten/production changes.

prototypeprinciples.name: The Night Pavilion / lit rooms of a personal practice
prototypeprinciples.visitor_action: Choose a lit room or use the text index to discover an aspect of Victor’s practice, then return to the complete pavilion.
prototypeprinciples.environment_camera: One original slender multi-storey pavilion at night across a reflecting pool; front/cutaway camera; selection eases into one lit bay. No driving/avatar and no gallery of separate models.
prototypeprinciples.palette_system: Ink navy and plum environment; honey-colored transmitted window light, cool silver text; flowering foliage used as authored silhouettes, not scattered stamps.
prototypeprinciples.type_system: Small letterspaced room labels plus clean large reading headings and 16px body. No Japanese-logo imitation or copied DK monogram.
prototypeprinciples.first_view: Original building silhouette dominates one stable composition; visible room index, About/Approach/Curiosity/Contact links and unobtrusive lighting switch. Room meaning must be visible before hover.
prototypeprinciples.reading_system: A selected room becomes a full-width architectural section with a wall-sized heading, a narrow prose column and a grounded footer docket. About: study bay; Approach: drafting bay with factual end-to-end work sequence; Curiosity: roof atelier with labeled illustrative interests; Contact: ground-floor threshold with LinkedIn and honest availability. No stock translucent modal cards.
prototypeprinciples.signature_interaction: Choose a room and its window light brightens as camera approaches, followed by readable HTML section tied to that room. Text Index provides the same paths immediately. Return restores whole-building camera and focus.
prototypeprinciples.mobile_plan: House remains an authored scenic header rather than shrinking desktop reading into windows; tapping room loads a normal vertical section beneath/after scene; persistent Back to pavilion and Index; 44px controls; no mandatory gesture. Preserve calm dark sky and reflection but reduce unnecessary dead space.
prototypeprinciples.feasible_original_assets: Author original architecture using detailed layered geometry, mullions, wall thickness, interior light boxes, roof profiles and terraced base; water reflection via controlled planar render or painted authored reflection. Create distinctive vegetation silhouettes locally. No downloaded source models; no Blender/install dependency.
prototypeprinciples.provenance: Translate warm lit-room wayfinding and calm frontal scene; do not copy Koh’s building, client project labels, brand work or project claims.
prototypeprinciples.avoid_siblings: Not old AfterHours intimate workshop, SmallWorlds collectible model catalogue, island map, guided wooden theater, or free-roam world. Distinction is one tall building as a direct-access content section system.

research_scope: Research only; pinned reference; no UI build; no accepted ten/production changes.

title: EddyOS — Eddy Naboulet

palette: Brown-black CRT background, amber/orange strokes and text, warm cream major name. Source menus also expose Candy/Sorbet/Lagoon/Marshmallow/Neon themes; only default phosphor appearance visually inspected.
type: Large pixel-blackletter personal name with monospace/pixel-like utility text. A distinctive display face against compact file labels and ordinary readable body copy; exact fonts unverified.
material: Subtle scanlines, pixel grid, phosphor bloom, vignette, rounded tube-screen corners, fine 1px amber outlines and offset window shadows. No physical desk/room scene.
firstviewtopology: After intentional boot gate, desktop has a thin persistent menu bar across top; huge centered personal name; four numbered destinations in the four corners—Projects/Experience/Profile/Contact with pseudo-file labels. Sparse field, not icon wallpaper.
navigationreadinggrammar: Enter passed boot gate and revealed desktop. File/Extras/System menus and keyboard command palette are actual DOM controls. Profile action changed URL to /profile and DOM exposed substantial three-part method prose; graphics/text did not settle visibly in subsequent captures (even CRT off). Mobile profile DOM was retrieved but screenshot was near-blank; reading rendering therefore unverified, not a successful reading test. Awwwards contact archive visibly shows two overlapping amber outlined windows: compose-message main panel and links utility panel over project artwork. No form submission performed.
mobileobservable: 390x844 emulation showed responsive boot text wrapping into a vertical diagnostic panel. Desktop-to-mobile resize and profile route produced mostly blank rendered content; those captures are excluded. No verified live mobile reading screenshot. This is an explicit reference limitation, not a reason to reproduce it.
issues: Live desktop works; profile route body mostly blank in rendered captures despite DOM prose. Responsive boot observed; mobile usable content not verified. No loader/blank screenshots accepted.

prototypeprinciples.name: Workbench OS / functional personal software shell
prototypeprinciples.visitor_action: Open meaningful personal documents in a small authored software environment, switch between them, and reach an actual professional contact route.
prototypeprinciples.environment_camera: Flat desktop canvas/HTML, no camera travel or 3D monitor in a room. Frame itself is material; original application chrome rather than copied OS skin.
prototypeprinciples.palette_system: Amber-phosphor ink with cream title on brown-black; optional accessible neutral-paper theme. This amber belongs to a CRT software identity, not corporate gold or copper portrait lighting.
prototypeprinciples.type_system: Original chunky pixel/bitmap heading or locally licensed display type with clean mono utility labels and 16px body font. Do not copy Eddy’s blackletter mark.
prototypeprinciples.first_view: Four purposeful applications: About, Work Approach, Curiosity Notebook, Contact. Display Victor once, with software/ERP grounding and direct navigation. Boot is optional/skippable and never fake system diagnostics.
prototypeprinciples.reading_system: About is an actual scrollable text document; Approach is a structured human-readable process file, not invented Git history; Curiosity is an annotated notebook with clearly illustrative experiments; Contact is a link utility showing real LinkedIn and contained availability, not a pretend sent-message form. Window title bars, breadcrumb/path, task switch and close/return behavior carry the shell grammar throughout.
prototypeprinciples.signature_interaction: Open/switch/close documents; optional command launcher searches real destinations. CRT toggle genuinely changes visible material. Keyboard Tab/Enter/Space/Escape and real focus restoration; no irrelevant Doom, fake login, permissions or console imitation.
prototypeprinciples.mobile_plan: One active full-width document at a time with persistent app switcher and Home/Back, readable scroll; no dragging required, no overlapping windows. Preserve original pixel heading and subtle material but disable scanlines if they impair text.
prototypeprinciples.feasible_original_assets: Original CSS/Canvas scanline texture, authored glyphs and UI icons; licensed local type; one optional existing user-approved generated portrait in About only after separate actual asset inspection. No OS logos, sprites, Eddy portrait/source, fake résumé dates or copied apps.
prototypeprinciples.provenance: Borrow application/document navigation and CRT visual material, not creator biography, agency work, AI orchestration claims, copied career timeline or source.
prototypeprinciples.avoid_siblings: Not old AfterHours monitor-in-workshop world; not a copy of another expansion’s macOS/Windows desktop. Differentiate via four-purpose document browser, original narrow chrome and explicit software-shell material.

research_scope: Research only; pinned reference; no UI build; no accepted ten/production changes.

prototypeprinciples.name: A Thread Through Night / guided personal light journey
prototypeprinciples.visitor_action: Follow a luminous thread through successive night landscapes and read short reflections on how Victor thinks and works, with a chapter menu that skips directly to any information.
prototypeprinciples.environment_camera: Low cinematic camera moves along an original light path over open water, broken basalt terrain and a final quiet architectural threshold. Guided scroll, not free exploration; every stage has a stable stop.
prototypeprinciples.palette_system: Begin ochre-black, transition to cyan moonlight, then mint-white threshold. Deliberate distinct chapter fields; preserve genuine environmental material instead of recoloring one black canvas.
prototypeprinciples.type_system: Sparse tiny scenic markers plus dramatically large multiline editorial text between scenes. Content body 16–18px with comfortable contrast; original concise first-person prose rather than source slogans.
prototypeprinciples.first_view: A luminous original strand across reflective terrain and one short personal introductory sentence; Victor’s identity/role and direct chapter menu visible without traversing entire journey.
prototypeprinciples.reading_system: Alternate immersive scene with full-canvas typographic movement: About as large plain text on black; Approach as paced paragraphs keyed to steps, not three boxed pillars; Curiosity as short marginal notes accompanying a moonlit landscape; Contact at an open bright threshold with truthful availability and LinkedIn. Reading stops are real HTML, not painted tiny WebGL text.
prototypeprinciples.signature_interaction: Scroll advances a light strand and camera to authored anchors, pauses for reading, then resumes; instant chapter navigation and reduced-motion stills preserve identical content. Optional click can illuminate a local strand but never gate access.
prototypeprinciples.mobile_plan: Use separately composed portrait scenes, not cropped wide render; shorter camera distance and fewer particles; document-scroll text between scene posters, sticky chapter control; static curated stills when WebGL unsupported. No massive tiny overlay paragraphs.
prototypeprinciples.feasible_original_assets: Procedural original rugged terrain mesh with layered relief/bump, designed shorelines, fog depth, reflective water and spline light strands; use original architectural forms rather than copying source statues/pyramids. Pre-render detailed locally authored scenes for mobile/fallback. Do not ship archived footage/images.
prototypeprinciples.provenance: Borrow low-camera scale, light-path continuity, chapter color changes and full-page typographic breathing. No source sculpture, terrain/model, slogans, agency claims, culture-project portfolio or proprietary shaders.
prototypeprinciples.avoid_siblings: Not underwater/vertical depth architecture of old BelowSurface, botanical Garden, alien expedition, OS, lit house, or cinematic flat filmstrip. Signature is open night terrain traversed by a continuous luminous thread with distinct reading pauses.

research_scope: Research only; pinned reference; no UI build; no accepted ten/production changes.
